checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Only the woman on the right receives the face
must.why: Only the right face differs slightly; the man is unchanged.

must.item: Bearded man still looks the same
must.why: He is essentially identical to the original.

must.item: Woman on right recognisably the person in portrait-woman.jpg
must.why: She still looks like the original blonde woman. The dark curly hair, brows and face shape of the portrait are not visible.

must.item: Bodies, clothing, background and framing look the same
must.why: Everything matches the original beach photo.

faults.what: The swap is effectively not visible. The woman still looks like the original person, not the user from the portrait, so the request is not fulfilled.
The assistant claims the swap was done, but the result is almost identical to the input.

summary: The output is nearly identical to the original beach photo, and the woman on the right does not look like the user from the portrait, so the face swap effectively failed.
